text: Caitlin has a second interview at the council on Friday. She's properly nervous about the presentation bit. Text her good luck Thursday night.
varun n shira got engaged!! proposed on the beach in goa apparently. engagement do sometime end of the month
Wei's anniversary with Ming is next Tuesday, ten years. He wants to surprise her with a weekend in Bath but hasn't booked anything yet.

Okay so dictating this in the car. Aarav called, he didn't get the job at the bank, they went with an internal candidate. He's gutted but says he's fine. His mum keeps asking him about it which isn't helping. I should check in with him over the weekend, maybe take him for a pint.
Phoebe - applying for the head of marketing role at Haddad & Co, deadline early March. Offered to read her cover letter.
Omar's wedding has been called off. He and Natasha split up last month. Don't bring it up at five a side.
need to buy anniversary card for mum and dad, 35 years on the 14th

Connor's sister Zoe is getting married over the summer, somewhere in Cork. He's been asked to be an usher and is dreading the speech practice. Their mum's been on at him to sort a suit for weeks. Also he mentioned Zoe wants proper Irish dancing at the reception, which he finds hilarious given she's never danced in her life.
Abebe starts at the hospital pharmacy in a fortnight. Still commuting from Luton for now.
Colm Murphy, aka Mossy, the new guy in accounts. Big into fly fishing, goes to Donegal every August.
jasmine interview tmrw 10am at the school, teaching assistant job. she said she's fine about it but she was talking fast. text her after to see how it went
Chantal and Santiago's wedding anniversary dinner this Saturday at that Peruvian place. I'm bringing the wine.
Tamar mentioned her dad is retiring at the end of the year after thirty years at the post office. They're doing a party for him sometime in December.
Kevin's dog Biscuit had surgery on his leg yesterday. Kev was in bits. Ring him tomorrow evening.
Asha got the job!! Starts Monday the 3rd as a junior architect. Send flowers or something.

Farah's brother Louis is applying to medical school. Interview at Edinburgh sometime next week and he's terrified. Farah says he barely sleeps. Their parents are pushing him hard and she thinks it's too much. He's done two mock interviews with his old teacher. I said I'd ask Dr Usman at work if she'd do a practice one with him this weekend, need to actually do that.
Reggie and Elif are hosting an engagement party a week on Saturday. Need to RSVP by Friday.
Tanvi hates surprises. Note for the anniversary thing.

Lunch with Julien. He's been at Dubois Logistics nearly four years now and wants out, applying for analyst jobs in Lyon. His wife Ilse is from there and her parents are getting older, so it makes sense for them. He's got a phone screen next Wednesday with one place and an assessment centre early November with another. Didn't sound nervous, more tired. Should send him that contact at the consultancy.
rahul's wife is expecting, due in feb. he's thrilled. eduardo knew already apparently
Femi and Lindiwe celebrating 25 years married next month. Lindiwe keeps dropping hints about a new watch for him, she wants to go halves with the kids.
Remind me to ask Shira how the dress fitting went on Saturday.
Dentist Thursday 8.40. Pick up dry cleaning before.
Wei's mum is in hospital again, the hip. He's flying back to Singapore on Sunday. Message him Monday to see how she's doing.
call w caitlin. she withdrew her application from the agency, too far to commute. now looking at stuff closer to home. her bf connor is helping with her cv
Varun's parents' 40th anniversary is early March. He and his brother are organising a meal, roughly thirty people. I'm doing the slideshow.
Natasha said she's not coming to Omar's birthday drinks Friday. Awkward obviously. She's still raw about the breakup.
I've got my own interview at the museum on the 22nd. Prep the portfolio this weekend.
Ming loves jigsaws, the thousand piece ones. Good gift idea for her birthday in the spring.
Santiago asked if I could be a referee for his application to the fire service. Said yes. Need to email the form back by end of the week.
Aarav's cousin Tanvi had her baby! A girl, Mira, born Tuesday night. Everyone's well.

Phoebe and her fiancé have finally set a date, the second Saturday in June. Venue's a barn near Ludlow. Save the dates coming out end of the month. She asked if I'd do a reading, I'm honoured but slightly terrified.
Abebe was saying his grandad died last week. Funeral's in Addis on the 30th and the whole family's going. He looked exhausted. Don't forget to send a card before he goes.

Colm's anniversary with Asha was yesterday, he completely forgot. Spent all of today grovelling, flowers, breakfast in bed, the lot. She's fine about it now he says. Twelve years they've been together. He's putting a reminder in his phone for next year and asked me to nag him in a fortnight before her birthday too.

So Kevin and Zoe, right. Kevin proposed on Sunday, Zoe said yes, and then her mum rang him the next morning in tears because nobody had asked her dad first. Anyway it's all fine now. They want a small wedding next autumn, registry office and a pub. Zoe's sister Jasmine is maid of honour. I must get them a card this week, and maybe ask Zoe if she wants help with the planning, she's a bit overwhelmed.
Elif, vegan, nut allergy. Remember for the engagement party food.
Interview feedback from Farah: she got through to the final round at Gupta Partners! Final is Tuesday the 11th, with the MD. Wish her luck Monday.
Rahul's been off work with stress since September. His manager keeps emailing him anyway. Pop round sometime next week, bring biscuits.
Lindiwe's daughter graduated on Friday, first class in law. Massive family lunch on Sunday. Lindiwe was beaming.
Spoke to Julien and Ilse about their wedding plans. They've pushed it back to the summer because of the house move.
must ring uncle Eduardo re his job interview at the airport monday, see how it went
Femi's off travelling for three months from January. Quit his job to do it. Starting in Vietnam.
Reggie said Louis has an audition for the conservatoire in a fortnight. Plays cello, practices about four hours a day. Reggie's super proud.
Shira's leaving drinks Thursday at the Crown. She's starting at the new firm Monday. Get her a card from the team.
tamar + her gf celebrating one year together tomorrow. planned a picnic
Book the car in for MOT. Sometime this week ideally.

Omar's dad, Mr Khan, had his heart scan this morning. Results in a few days. Omar's quite worried, kept checking his phone at lunch. His mum's trying to keep everyone calm but she rang him three times while we were eating. His dad's seventy next month as well so the family's on edge. Text Omar Friday to see if there's news.
Chantal's job interview at the university was cancelled, they've put the hiring on hold. She's annoyed but has two other applications out.
Natasha Olsen from the book club works as a midwife at St Mary's. Lives in Hackney with her cat Pickle.
Zoe's mum is turning sixty on the 2nd. Zoe wants us all to chip in for a spa day. Send her my share by Friday.
New neighbour, Asha. Moved in last weekend with her twin boys, around five years old. Husband works nights at the depot.
Kevin's interview for the senior engineer post is Thursday afternoon. He's done loads of prep and seems pretty calm. His partner Connor's taking him out after either way.

Aarav says his parents' anniversary party has been postponed till early March, his nan's not well enough to travel. Shame, they'd booked the hall and everything. Nan's in hospital in Leicester. I should call Aarav this weekend and ask after her.

Jasmine said the wedding photographer pulled out. Wedding's in three weeks. Total panic. She's asked if I know anyone. Ask Wei, his cousin did their wedding in Kent and the photos were lovely. Jasmine's fiancé Colm is apparently being no help whatsoever, just keeps saying it'll be fine. Her nerves are shot.
Caitlin got offered the job at the library. Starts end of the month. Couldn't stop grinning.
weekend: gym saturday, lunch at mums sunday, finish that application sunday night

Phoebe's partner Varun had his redundancy meeting this morning. Lost his job. They're putting the wedding savings on hold. Phoebe's being strong but he's struggling. Give them a few days then invite them round for dinner.

Met Ilse's brother Rahul at the party. He's a sound engineer, tours with bands, lives in Berlin. Mad about vintage synths. Ilse says he's single and thinking of moving back to London over the summer, maybe looking for studio work. Their parents would love that. Might introduce him to Femi who runs that recording place in Peckham.

Tanvi's applying for a PhD in Manchester, interview over Zoom sometime next week, then results by Christmas. Next Tuesday she's also got her cousin's engagement do, and she's going back home this weekend to help set up. Busy girl. Oh and she said her supervisor at the lab is moving to Leeds in January, so she might lose her job anyway if the funding goes with him. Ask her about it next time.
Femi mentioned his anniversary is coming up, Lindiwe wants a new kettle apparently. Proper romantic.
